comment.narrative: The development and launch of the EU4ME Empowering Municipalities for European Engagement initiative represent a significant step in decentralizing communication efforts effectively bridging the gap between the EU and Montenegros local communities. Through this initiative an actionable plan was established for municipalities which included tailored events and activities aligned with the communication strategy. These activities were planned with direct input from the municipalities gathered through applications and discussions at a February networking event at Europe House ensuring that the strategys goals were grounded in the needs of local communities.The European Tour initiative celebrated for the first time across multiple municipalities further highlights this strategic alignment. By including diverse locations and demographics EU4ME expanded its outreach effectively promoting European values and increasing awareness of Europe Days significance. This widespread engagement adhered to the communication strategys goal of fostering a broader understanding of the EU within Montenegros local settings.Enhanced visual branding and content innovation such as the introduction of new social media formats like reels and educational carousels further showcase the projects adaptive alignment with strategic guidelines. These formats generated greater traffic on EU4MEs social media channels indicating the teams responsiveness to evolving digital communication trends and the strategic focus on expanding reach and engagement. In addition the regular engagement of a graphic designer for both online and offline materials contributed to an improved cohesive visual identity across platforms underscoring the projects commitment to highquality recognizable branding.The EU4ME teams coordination of interviews media inquiries and event speeches for Ministry of European Affairs MEA officials alongside the development of a major campaign in close consultation with both MEA and the EU Delegation reflects a disciplined adherence to the communication strategys goals while demonstrating flexibility in response to evolving institutional priorities.These efforts collectively affirm that EU4MEs information design and delivery have been consistently executed as per the communication strategy ensuring that the projects message reaches Montenegrin citizens effectively while reflecting the core principles and objectives of EUMontenegro engagement.

comment.narrative: The EU4ME project conceived the European Tour initiative to enable Montenegro to celebrate Europe Day first time in a way that included various municipalities throughout the country. This initiative aims to promote European values and increase awareness of the significance of Europe Day within local communities. In the 13 edition of Eurokaz magazine December 2023 three success stories focused on EUfunded projects. These included the Regional Housing Programme RHP crossborder cooperation between Italy Albania and Montenegro ITAALBMNE and crossborder cooperation between Montenegro and Serbia MNESRB. The stories developed in collaboration with local journalists offered an indepth look at EU support through storytelling in a reportage format while steering clear of administrative and bureaucratic language. This journalistic approach added significant value to the presentation of these projects. The project organized and supported over 20 distinct events in different formats such as panel consultations quiz bazar visits to municipalities Info days etc. These activities spanned a broad spectrum of themes from environmental awareness and consumer rights to gender equality and scientific achievement reflecting the EUs core values and Montenegros strategic priorities. Events engaged more than 2500 individuals from various target groups including students civil and local servants NGOs representatives media general public etc. EU4ME marked the European Day of Languages with an online quiz for elementary studentsn partnership with the Ministry of Education Science and Innovation MESI followed by an award ceremony. World Consumer Rights Day was marked through an Info Day in cooperation with the Ministry for Economic Development focusing on consumer protection.On social media on the ocassion of the Day of Girls and Women in Science EU4ME showcased outstanding Montenegrin female scientists in partnership with MESI. For Womens Day notable women from the negotiation structure were promoted. By blending formats and various EU themed events EU4ME successfully engaged diverse target groups and promoted key topics enhancing EU visibility. Target audiences demonstrated strong interest in activities organized for EU thematic days. They actively participated posed questions and engaged with the content provided during these events. On social media high engagement and visibility of project and its activities was recorded 550 posts across different platforms 1807 interactions more than 20000 visits to website eu4me.

comment.narrative: The methodology for conveying key messages to target groups has been successfully determined and updated reflecting responsiveness to changes in the communication context. The EU4ME project actively engaged in continuous monitoring and assessment of the communication landscape allowing for timely adjustments to strategies and messaging.For instance the intensive communication campaign launched to highlight Montenegros Initial Benchmarking Assessment Report IBAR ensured that key messages about Montenegros EU accession progress were effectively communicated to the public. This campaign included targeted media appearances press releases and social media initiatives tailored to resonate with various audiences and stakeholders.Additionally the detailed action plan developed for the Evropski ir initiative included specific messaging tailored to different municipalities ensuring relevance and clarity in communication. Regular consultations and trainings for local communicators and journalists further strengthened the understanding of EUrelated topics enabling them to effectively relay updated messages to their respective audiences.The incorporation of feedback mechanisms and audience engagement metrics has also played a crucial role in refining the messaging strategy. By analyzing audience reactions and engagement levels across social media platforms the EU4ME project has been able to adapt its messaging to better address the interests and concerns of the target groups. This proactive approach has ensured that key messages remain relevant impactful and aligned with the evolving context of EUMontenegro relations.

comment.narrative: The EU4ME Empowering Municipalities for European Engagement initiative was developed into Action plan for implementation of different events and activities in selected municipalities. The event titled EU4ME Empowering Municipalities for European Engagement took place on February 19 2024 at the Europe House. That was a networking event but also other events such as Signing the MoU between municipalities MEA and UoM consultations with NGO. There were 11 representatives of municipalities and representatives of EU4ME project MEA and EH. The participants from municipalities were satisfied with the event they were very active engaging in activities asking questions and giving suggestions. Municipalities gave their proposals for activities in their application for the participation in the initiative EU4ME Empowering Municipalities for European Engagement and also those proposals were discussed at networking event organised for them at Europe House in February. Also The EU4ME project conceived the European Tour initiative to enable Montenegro to celebrate Europe Day first time in a way that included various municipalities throughout the country. This initiative aims to promote European values and increase awareness of the significance of Europe Day within local communities.

By using accessible language and focusing on reallife beneficiaries these stories bridged gaps in understanding about how the EU contributes to local and regional development enhancing familiarity with EUsupported initiatives and the institutions behind them.The European Tour initiative with its reach across multiple municipalities brought EU values and assistance programs into local communities connecting the public directly with the EUs role and vision for Montenegros future. This outreach initiative the first of its kind allowed citizens in various regions to actively participate in EUrelated events promoting awareness of the EUs institutional structure and support programs in an engaging communitycentered manner.Educational events such as the European Day of Languages quiz and the World Consumer Rights Info Day served as practical platforms to introduce younger audiences and citizens to EU principles institutions and their associated rights and responsibilities. description.narrative: Understanding of EUs efforts and projects in Montenegro by the general public and other stakeholders improved, both in terms of benefits and responsibilities;

comment.narrative: EU4ME made measurable progress in raising awareness and deepening understanding of the EUs role in Montenegro among both the general public and key stakeholders. By using diverse communication channels and creative event formats EU4ME effectively highlighted the tangible benefits of EUsupported projects while fostering a sense of shared responsibility for Montenegros integration journey.The European Tour initiative for example brought the celebration of Europe Day to multiple municipalities directly engaging communities with the values and benefits the EU brings to Montenegro. These events highlighted EU standards on education language diversity and consumer rights enabling participants to connect these themes with the broader responsibilities and benefits of EU membership.Through these combined efforts EU4ME has effectively communicated both the advantages and commitments associated with EU projects contributing to a stronger understanding of Montenegros EU integration among diverse segments of the population. This increased awareness aligns well with the projects goal of enhancing public and stakeholder comprehension of the EUs role in Montenegro.

comment.narrative: EU4ME project made significant strides in expanding synergies with multipliers and other interested parties resulting in enhanced coordination and outreach on EUrelated topics. This expansion was achieved through strategic partnerships with EUfunded projects NGOs think tanks universities and schools.A variety of joint initiatives were developed to foster collaboration including training sessions for local communicators and journalists which were wellreceived and indicated high satisfaction among participants. These training sessions not only strengthened the capacity of local stakeholders to convey EUrelated messages but also established a network of communicators who share best practices and resources.The project organized diverse events such as the Ministerial summit in Podgorica and the Conference for MSMEs in Bar which brought together representatives from various sectors including government officials civil society and the private sector. These gatherings facilitated dialogue and the exchange of ideas significantly enhancing the quality of collaboration.Furthermore initiatives like the Evropski ir effectively engaged seven municipalities ensuring that local authorities were actively involved in disseminating EUrelated information. This local engagement contributed to a broader outreach strategy that reached more than 2500 individuals from various target groups including students civil servants and members of the media.The development and promotion of the Eurokaz magazine also exemplified this synergy. By highlighting EUfunded projects and opportunities the publication served as a vital tool for disseminating information and fostering connections among stakeholders.

title.narrative: Understanding of EUs efforts and projects in Montenegro by the general public and other stakeholders improved, both in terms of benefits and responsibilities;

description.narrative: Understanding of EUs efforts and projects in Montenegro by the general public and other stakeholders improved, both in terms of benefits and responsibilities;

comment.narrative: EU4ME made measurable progress in raising awareness and deepening understanding of the EUs role in Montenegro among both the general public and key stakeholders. By using diverse communication channels and creative event formats EU4ME effectively highlighted the tangible benefits of EUsupported projects while fostering a sense of shared responsibility for Montenegros integration journey.The European Tour initiative for example brought the celebration of Europe Day to multiple municipalities directly engaging communities with the values and benefits the EU brings to Montenegro. This handson engagement allowed local audiences to experience EU values through community events and conversations promoting a clearer understanding of the EUs objectives and Montenegros role in the accession process.The coverage of crossborder cooperation projects through feature stories in Eurokaz magazine further contributed to this understanding. These stories crafted in a narrative style with local journalists provided an accessible look at EUfunded projects like the Regional Housing Programme and crossborder initiatives with neighboring countries. By focusing on relatable humancentered storytelling rather than administrative language these articles made the EUs impact in Montenegro more comprehensible and meaningful for a wide readership.Educational activities such as the European Day of Languages quiz which engaged 479 students and the Info Day on World Consumer Rights which attracted 100 participants provided practical examples of EU principles at work. These events highlighted EU standards on education language diversity and consumer rights enabling participants to connect these themes with the broader responsibilities and benefits of EU membership.Through these combined efforts EU4ME has effectively communicated both the advantages and commitments associated with EU projects contributing to a stronger understanding of Montenegros EU integration among diverse segments of the population. This increased awareness aligns well with the projects goal of enhancing public and stakeholder comprehension of the EUs role in Montenegro.
